tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground, as rendered behind the page's content (the body gradient, averaged). Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: page-text
tokens.usage: Default body text on `page-bg`: the colour most of the page's text uses that reads on it (8.8:1).

tokens.name: page-surface
tokens.usage: Surface most of the page's running text sits on (cards, panels).

tokens.name: color-spatial-purple
tokens.usage: Interactive elements, focus indicators. Used as background on `body::before`, `.nav-link:hover`, `.stat-icon`; shadow/glow on `.logo-icon`, `.nav-link:hover`, `.page-title`; border on `.stat-card:hover`.

tokens.name: color-cyan-highlight
tokens.usage: Active elements, spatial highlights. Used as background on `body::before`, `.stat-icon`, `.card-badge`; border on `.content-card:hover`.

tokens.name: color-glass-white
tokens.usage: Used as background on `.header`, `.nav-link`, `.stat-card`; border on `.header`, `.nav-link`, `.stat-card`; text on `.page-subtitle`, `.stat-title`, `.stat-insight`. 8.8:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-glass-dark
tokens.usage: Used as background on `.header`, `.nav-link`, `.stat-card`; border on `.header`, `.nav-link`, `.stat-card`; text on `.page-subtitle`, `.stat-title`, `.stat-insight`. 1.3:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: badge-warning-bg
tokens.usage: Painted directly by the reference page: background on `.badge-warning`; text on `.badge-warning`. 10.2:1 on `page-bg`.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero and page titles — as `h1.page-title` on the reference page.

styles.name: label
